semantics.goal: Pass the complete carried-object envelope through an x-normal aperture, reorient inside the bounded chamber, pass a y-normal aperture that rejects the first orientation, brake, and hold the terminal pose.
excludes: one fixed orientation for both frames
motion above or around either solid frame
frame contact used for reorientation or braking
geometry selected after observing method rankings

evidence: front and rear object extrema cross the first plane
complete envelope remains inside the first opening
payload is inside the declared chamber
second-aperture orientation error is below threshold
front and rear object extrema cross the second plane
complete envelope remains inside the second opening
object speed is below threshold inside the declared exit interval

public: tcp and carried-object pose and twist

success: the complete envelope crosses both frames in order
the second orientation is reached only inside the chamber
the object brakes in the final exit interval
anti_bypass: first opening rejects the second yaw and second opening rejects the first yaw
dense geometry audit finds no fixed yaw that fits both
separate four-bit contact masks for each frame
front and rear extrema must cross each plane

requirements: both requested approach modes complete every ordered event
no fixed yaw fits both openings
every physics-substep frame contact is retained

historical_evidence_policy: No prior obstacle-transfer or single-aperture evidence is reusable as sequential-aperture performance evidence.
